headline: COA Seeks ₱2.2 Billion to Revive Pre-Audits for Government Infrastructure
seoTitle: COA Seeks ₱2.2B to Revive Infrastructure Pre-Audits | FMB News
seoDescription: The Commission on Audit is seeking about ₱2.2 billion to strengthen pre-auditing and digital verification of government infrastructure projects.
deck: The proposal would strengthen checks before public funds are released and expand digital verification of infrastructure projects.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News morning brief reports that the Commission on Audit is seeking about ₱2.2 billion to revive and modernize pre-auditing for government infrastructure projects during deliberations on its proposed 2027 budget.
The proposal is intended to strengthen checks before full payment is released, including greater use of digital location verification and physical project inspection.

sections.heading: What pre-audit means
paragraphs: A pre-audit checks selected transactions before funds are fully disbursed, while a post-audit reviews transactions after payment. Supporters argue that pre-audit can reduce the risk of paying for incomplete, irregular or non-existent projects, but the system also requires enough trained auditors and engineers to avoid slowing legitimate procurement.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Baguio City Rep. Mauricio Domogan has previously filed House Resolution No. 291 urging mandatory pre-audit requirements for government-funded programs and projects. The approved newsroom brief says lawmakers are also considering geotagging and digital mapping as part of the proposed modernization framework.

FMB News did not independently reproduce every monetary and staffing detail in the brief from a same-day primary COA document, so those details remain attributed to the approved editorial package rather than expanded beyond it.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Infrastructure spending involves large public outlays and long project timelines. Earlier verification can improve accountability if it is designed to catch irregularities without creating new bottlenecks for legitimate projects.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The next step is the House budget process, including whether lawmakers approve dedicated funding for expanded pre-audit staffing, engineering review and digital verification tools in the 2027 budget.
